svg.title: Mean, median and mode on two posteriors
svg.desc: Left: a nearly symmetric Beta(28, 16) whose three summaries almost coincide. Right: a right-skewed Beta(2, 12) whose mean, median and mode are far apart.
svg.text: all three within 0.007 of one another
the mean sits well to the right of the peak
A long right tail pulls the mean away from the peak, so which summary you report changes the number a reader carries away.
On the left the choice is nearly free; on the right it is not.
